(() => { const v = document.querySelector('.um-view'); const r = v.getBoundingClientRect(); for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) v.dispatchEvent(new WheelEvent('wheel', { deltaY: -40, ctrlKey: true, clientX: r.left + r.width * 0.5, clientY: r.top + r.height * 0.35, bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); return 'wheel zoom ' + window.__um.zoom.z.toFixed(2) + ' zoomed=' + document.querySelector('.um-stage').hasAttribute('data-zoomed'); })()

(() => { const v = document.querySelector('.um-view'); const r = v.getBoundingClientRect(); const T = (id, x, y) => new Touch({ identifier: id, target: v, clientX: x, clientY: y }); const cx = r.left + r.width * 0.45, cy = r.top + r.height * 0.4; let a = [T(1, cx - 40, cy), T(2, cx + 40, cy)]; v.dispatchEvent(new TouchEvent('touchstart', { touches: a, targetTouches: a, changedTouches: a, bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); a = [T(1, cx - 160, cy - 10), T(2, cx + 160, cy + 10)]; v.dispatchEvent(new TouchEvent('touchmove', { touches: a, targetTouches: a, changedTouches: a, bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); const mid = window.__um.zoom.z; a = [T(1, cx - 400, cy - 10), T(2, cx + 400, cy + 10)]; v.dispatchEvent(new TouchEvent('touchmove', { touches: a, targetTouches: a, changedTouches: a, bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); return 'pinch ' + mid.toFixed(2) + ' then capped ' + window.__um.zoom.z.toFixed(2); })()

(() => { const v = document.querySelector('.um-view'); const T = (id, x, y) => new Touch({ identifier: id, target: v, clientX: x, clientY: y }); const left = [T(1, 100, 300)]; v.dispatchEvent(new TouchEvent('touchend', { touches: left, targetTouches: left, changedTouches: [T(2, 900, 300)], bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); return 'one finger up'; })()
